Game Overview

Cooking in the City of Winds puts players into a cooking experience centered on embrace the culinary festival in the magical City of Winds. Craft exquisite dishes like pudding, bubble tea, and enchanting marmalade desserts. Unleash your artistic flair by decorating with elegance, as the city's taste buds await your delicious creations. Can you rise to the top and captivate every palate?

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Cooking in the City of Winds is easy to pick up. Embrace the culinary festival in the magical City of Winds!
